predecessorPackageDigest264.note: the previously recorded value does not reproduce under the established method, which derives §263's recorded digest exactly. The §264 package itself verifies clean (shasum -c REPORT-264.sha256, 4/4 OK), so the frozen bytes are intact and only this living index held a value that cannot be derived from them. Recorded rather than silently replaced. See §265 report section 9.
predecessorPackageDigest264.rootCause: ESTABLISHED AT §266: 0be6f8c3… is the §262 package digest, reproducible today from verification/expert-hazlenz-262-…/REPORT-262.sha256. §264 carried §262's value forward into this living index instead of computing its own. This is a CURRENT-STATE INDEX METADATA DEFECT, not frozen-evidence corruption: all six §26x packages verify byte-clean under shasum -c, and the §265 commit touched no frozen package member.

confirmationTrigger.computedAt: persistence time, stored once, never recomputed on read
confirmationTrigger.runsOnlyOn: an ADMITTED analysis; every other outcome records not-applicable
confirmationTrigger.rule: confirmation is REQUIRED when the admitted posture's requiredBy contains (a) a driverRole of UNRESOLVED_PROPERTY_CONTROLLING_CONTINUATION, or (b) a driverRole of UNRESOLVED_RESPONSE_OR_FOLLOW_UP while POSTURE_PERMITS_CONTINUED_WORK[posture] is true
confirmationTrigger.bothBranchesRequired: branch (a) catches over-restriction, the only direction §254 observed; branch (b) catches under-restriction, which is the dangerous direction and must not be dropped

trustBoundary.deterministicPath: the client calls /safescope-v2/classify, holds the result and posts it back; the server does not establish that what it stores equals what it returned. Acceptable for the advisory deterministic path, and the reason every historical row is client_supplied.
trustBoundary.expertPath: the server runs the analysis itself and stores what it obtained. producer=server_authored is assigned from a literal in one service and is protected by a database CHECK constraint requiring a real execution row.

deliberatelyNotProven.governedCitation: NOT EXERCISED AT ALL. Every §262 execution transmits zero governed records, so Expert may cite nothing. Fail-closed by design: the only unbuilt-loader source of approved regulatory text was the client-supplied snapshot, and accepting that would let a request inject text labelled as governed.
deliberatelyNotProven.liveProviderTransportFromADeployedInstan: one live call was contemplated by §260 and has not been spent
deliberatelyNotProven.downstreamActivation: §265 activated ONE consumer of effectiveDecision — finding finalization. The other five §260 section 11 consumers are contained by it rather than guarded in their own right: they reach an Expert conclusion only through a finalized finding today, which a future feature reading an analysis directly would bypass. A settled analysis still reconciles ZERO findings; the guard refuses, it does not create.
deliberatelyNotProven.expertFrontendAgainstADeployedInstance: the workflow is proven against the local stack over real HTTP with a substituted transport. No deployed instance has served it, and no hosted provider leg has ever been spent from it.
deliberatelyNotProven.reviewerRevisionOfASettledAnalysis: not built. One settlement per analysis in the beta workflow, carried as PRODUCT DECISION DEFERRED rather than as a claim that the decision is permanently irreversible.

acceptedLimitations.statement: The model classifies an unresolved fact as continuation-controlling or as routine follow-up, and §254 observed it erring toward over-restriction. The product does not rely on that classification being right: an admitted analysis whose posture turns on it is held in ANALYSIS_AWAITING_CONFIRMATION until a person settles it.
acceptedLimitations.containedBy: the deterministic confirmation rule, both branches

acceptedLimitations.statement: The Expert route runs its own deterministic analysis for Expert's premises rather than reading the client-supplied snapshot the inspector is looking at. That is what makes the premises server-owned, and it means the two may diverge.
acceptedLimitations.containedBy: nothing yet; reconciling them is a later-slice product question

acceptedLimitations.statement: A contained declaration refusal with an admitted posture and a whole-output refusal with preserved truth both derive to ANALYSIS_UNRESOLVED, because §252 gives PRESERVE_UNRESOLVED precedence deliberately. They stay distinguishable on the execution record, not in the product state.
